name: Argumentum ad culpam
source:
In a world where great powers can easily manifest in material form and contracts can bestow magnificent magical powers, you can become a wizard without any effort. However, what price must you pay for it?

A wizard has discovered that the power granted him by the mighty Duke Luthedor is fading, while the Duke's body is nothing but an empty shell. Will he be skilled enough to regain the magic? Will he want it back?

Argumentum ad culpam will present a gothic world of magic and supernatural beings called transcendents. Each of these beings wants to carry out their plans for Luthedor's future. The game's core is battles of wits, where the wizard can support any side with his own reasoning, trying to get the best position for himself. But what his best is, that's for you to decide.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个强大的力量可以轻易地以物质形式显现，契约可以赋予宏伟的魔力的世界里，你可以毫不费力地成为一名巫师。然而，你必须为此付出什么代价呢？

一名巫师发现强大的卢德多公爵赋予他的力量正在消失，而公爵的身体只剩下一具空壳。他能熟练地恢复魔法吗？他会想要回来吗？

《Argumentum ad culpam》将呈现一个充满魔法和超自然生物的哥特世界。这些人中的每一个都想为卢德多的未来实现他们的计划。游戏的核心是斗智斗勇，巫师可以用自己的推理支持任何一方，试图为自己争取到最好的位置。但他最好的是什么，那是由你决定的。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370650/]Steam[/url]]
